title: On an Erdös Problem about the Maximum Modulus of Littlewood Polynomials on the Unit Circl
summary: Making a progress in an Erdös problem dating back to 1957, we show that $$\max_{t \in {\Bbb R}}{|P_n(e^{it})|^2} \geq n+1 + \frac{1}{38}n^{1/3}$$ for every polynomial $P_n$ of degree $n$ with all of its coefficients in $\{-1,1\}$.
